capabilities.title: All Book Tickers Stream
capabilities.reason: The per-symbol bookTicker subscriptions provide the same fields at real-time speed for the fixed 14-symbol universe; the all-symbol stream is slower and broader.

capabilities.title: Diff. Book Depth Streams
capabilities.reason: The bounded paper SOR consumes the official 20-level partial book; full local-book reconstruction is not required by the current execution contract.

capabilities.title: Individual Symbol Book Ticker Streams
capabilities.reason: Real-time best bid, ask, quantities and spread are consumed by paper execution and diagnostics.

capabilities.title: Partial Book Depth Streams
capabilities.reason: The deterministic paper SOR consumes a bounded 20-level public book.

capabilities.title: RPI Diff. Book Depth Streams
capabilities.reason: Real-time RPI-inclusive deltas are continuity-checked and reduced alongside hourly complete RPI snapshots without assuming paper fills.

capabilities.title: Aggregate Trade Streams
capabilities.reason: Real-time taker flow is reduced into five-second buy and sell notional windows.

capabilities.title: All Market Liquidation Order Stream
capabilities.reason: One all-market stream supplies forced-order flow for the complete fixed universe.

capabilities.title: All Market Mini Tickers Stream
capabilities.reason: The five-minute REST snapshot already persists validated 24-hour statistics for every required symbol.

capabilities.title: All Market Tickers Streams
capabilities.reason: The five-minute REST snapshot already persists the complete ticker fields for the fixed universe.

capabilities.title: Composite Index Symbol Information Streams
capabilities.reason: The current paper universe contains ordinary single-asset USDT perpetuals and no composite-index contract.

capabilities.title: Continuous Contract Kline/Candlestick Streams
capabilities.reason: The fixed universe uses named perpetual symbols and consumes their individual symbol kline stream.

capabilities.title: Contract Info Stream
capabilities.reason: Listing, settlement, contract-status and notional-bracket changes are retained immediately for fail-closed paper eligibility.

capabilities.title: Individual Symbol Mini Ticker Stream
capabilities.reason: The complete individual ticker and REST snapshot supersede this reduced field set.

capabilities.title: Individual Symbol Ticker Streams
capabilities.reason: Validated five-minute REST 24-hour statistics are sufficient for current paper sizing and avoid 14 additional one-second streams.

capabilities.title: Kline/Candlestick Streams
capabilities.reason: The current one-minute candle is retained for intraminute market state and feature projection.

capabilities.title: Liquidation Order Streams
capabilities.reason: The all-market liquidation stream supplies the same selected-symbol events on one subscription.

capabilities.title: Mark Price Stream
capabilities.reason: Mark price, index price, estimated settlement and funding are required by the paper mark and risk surface.

capabilities.title: Mark Price Stream for All market
capabilities.reason: Per-symbol mark streams constrain the feed to the fixed universe and expose the same required fields.

capabilities.title: Multi-Assets Mode Asset Index
capabilities.reason: The L2 paper book uses a single USDT collateral convention and does not model multi-assets auto-exchange.

capabilities.title: Trading Session Stream
capabilities.reason: The fixed universe contains crypto perpetuals, not TradFi perpetual underlyings with exchange sessions.
